intro.finance: Your sales, Racheeta's commission, refunds, payouts and what Racheeta owes you right now.
intro.setup: Register, submit your licences, get verified by Racheeta, then activate your store.
intro.catalog: SKUs, product options (size, pack, colour) with their own price and stock, and product photos.
intro.delivery: Your delivery fees per governorate and how your prices treat tax.
intro.reports: Sales, the 20% commission, delivery and tax, refunds and payouts for a period, with a CSV download.

market.waitingRefund: Waiting for Racheeta finance to refund the buyer.
market.sellerFunded: Store-funded: these discounts reduce your merchandise value, so Racheeta's 20% is calculated after them.
market.statementInfo: Racheeta keeps {{rate}}% of each completed sale after store discounts. Racheeta-funded coupons never reduce what you are paid.

checks.no_negative_seller_payable: No seller is owed a negative amount
checks.every_paid_order_has_payment_entry: Every paid order has a payment entry
checks.no_negative_seller_receivable: No seller owes a negative amount
checks.payable_and_receivable_netted: No seller is both owed and owing

finance.title: Marketplace finance
finance.intro: Payments, completion and commission, refunds, disputes, seller payouts and reconciliation.
finance.simulated: Simulation only: no payment provider is connected and no real money moves. Every action is recorded in the immutable ledger.
finance.forbidden: Your staff account does not have the finance permission.
finance.referenceHint: e.g. COD remittance or transfer number — fictional
finance.reconciled: Reconciled: every ledger balance matches the orders, refunds and payouts.
finance.platformFunded: Racheeta coupons are paid by Racheeta: the seller's merchandise value, commission and payout are unchanged.
finance.immutable: Ledger entries are append-only: corrections are new compensating entries, never edits.
finance.policyHint: Each order keeps the rate and version it was placed with; a new version never changes existing orders.

market.youOweHint: A refund came after your payout; it is taken from your next sales first.
market.deliveryAfterAddress: The delivery fee is added when you choose the delivery governorate.
market.taxIncluded: Prices include {{label}} of {{amount}} (declared by the seller).
market.chargesNoCommission: Delivery fees and seller-declared tax go to the seller in full: no commission is taken on them.
market.documentsIntro: Issued when Racheeta finance verifies the payment, plus a credit note for each refund. Printable.
market.noDocuments: No documents yet: they are issued once the payment is verified.
market.sellerOfRecord: The seller named above sold these goods. Racheeta operates the marketplace and collected the payment on the seller's behalf.
market.documentNotice: Local demonstration document: fictional data, no real payment.

sellerSetup.selling: Your products are offered and can be bought.
sellerSetup.notSelling: Your products are not offered yet.
sellerSetup.pharmacyIntro: Your pharmacy keeps its healthcare provider profile and workspace. Opening a store adds a linked seller workspace: you then upload your licence, Racheeta verifies it, and you activate the store. Prescription medicines are never sold online.
sellerSetup.pharmacyLinked: This store belongs to your pharmacy's provider profile; it stops selling if the pharmacy loses its verification.
sellerSetup.needVerification: Request verification from your business profile; Racheeta reviews your documents.
sellerSetup.documentsIntro: Private: only your owner/managers and Racheeta reviewers can open them.
sellerSetup.fileRules: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. PDFs with scripts or attachments are refused.
sellerSetup.catalogIntro: Add options with their own SKU, price and stock, and upload photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP). Products are created in your business profile.
sellerSetup.noVariants: No options: the product is sold as one item.
sellerSetup.variantStockHint: After the first option, stock is kept per option; change it with a stock adjustment (Inventory).
sellerSetup.photoRules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 3 MB, at least 64×64 pixels.
sellerSetup.taxIntro: How your prices treat tax. The default is no tax line.
sellerSetup.taxDisclaimer: Racheeta does not decide your tax obligations. Declare a tax only if your business is required to charge it; you are responsible for it.
sellerSetup.deliveryIntro: A fee per governorate; the default applies elsewhere. Without any setting, delivery is free. No commission is taken on delivery.
sellerSetup.adminIntro: Review seller licences, then verify, reject or suspend the business. A store sells only when verified, documents approved and activated by the seller.
sellerSetup.commissionNote: Commission is 20% of merchandise after seller discounts; delivery fees and seller-declared tax carry no commission.

inquiries.title: Ask the owner
inquiries.intro: Your question goes to the owner inside Racheeta. You'll be notified when they answer.
inquiries.messageHint: At least 10 characters. Don't include payment details.
inquiries.shareContact: Share my phone number and e-mail with the owner
inquiries.sent: Inquiry sent. Follow it from My property inquiries.
inquiries.loginToAsk: Log in to ask the owner
inquiries.myIntro: Questions you sent to property owners and their answers.
inquiries.empty: You have not sent any inquiry yet.
inquiries.ownerIntro: Questions from people interested in your listings. Answer or close each one.
inquiries.contactPrivate: The person did not share contact details; answer here.
inquiries.listingGone: This listing is no longer public.
